title: Lab Safety: The Spill Decision
description: W7 composable game (case_sim) in English (i18n demonstration) — score + lives + hints over branching laboratory-safety decisions. Passes the W6 anti-slop gate: reachable nodes, real choices, score tied to decisions, rationale on every consequence.

screens.title: A Spill in the Lab
screens.subtitle: Safety Decision Game
screens.body_html: You are working in a chemistry lab when an accident happens. Every decision affects safety. Correct judgment earns confidence; mistakes cost a life. You have three lives.

screens.title: Ground Rules
screens.body_html:
Before you start, remember:

  • People first: protect yourself and others before property.
  • Know the chemical: the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) drives the response.
  • Contain, don't spread: never wash unknown chemicals down the drain.

screens.title: Case: A Beaker Shatters
screens.intro_html: A beaker of dilute hydrochloric acid slips and shatters on the bench. Liquid is spreading toward a colleague. You may ask for a hint, but hints cost confidence points.

hints.text: For a chemical spill, the first priority is people, not cleanup.
Acids are neutralized with a mild base or a dedicated spill kit, not water alone.

nodes.content_html: The acid is spreading. What do you do first?

choices.text_html: Warn your colleague and move them away from the spill.
choices.feedback_html: Correct. People come first — you prevent a chemical burn.

choices.text_html: Take a photo for the incident report before doing anything.
choices.feedback_html: Documentation matters, but not before safety. The delay let the acid reach the edge. You lost a life.

choices.text_html: Pour a bucket of water over it to dilute it immediately.
choices.feedback_html: Dangerous: flooding an acid spill can splash and spread it, and washing chemicals into the floor drain is a violation. The situation escalated.

nodes.content_html: Your colleague is safe. The acid is still on the bench. Next step?

choices.text_html: Use the acid spill kit (neutralizer) and wear gloves and goggles.
choices.feedback_html: Excellent. The spill kit neutralizes the acid safely while you stay protected.

choices.text_html: Wipe it up quickly with paper towels and bare hands.
choices.feedback_html: Bare hands with acid risks burns, and paper towels don't neutralize it. You lost a life.

nodes.content_html: The spill is neutralized and cleaned. The final summary is below. Choose 'Continue' to close the case.

choices.text_html: Close the case and see your confidence score.

feedback.correct_html: You handled the incident calmly and safely — people first, then proper neutralization.
feedback.incorrect_html: Some critical safety steps were missed. Review the feedback and try again.

screens.title: Summary
screens.body_html: Chemical spill order: protect people, then contain and neutralize with the correct kit, then report. Never flood an acid spill or wash chemicals down the drain.
